Pemeriksaan ini menggunakan konteks memori sebelumnya, node Graphify lokal, dan penelusuran source aktual. Query CLI Graphify tidak selesai sehingga dihentikan; graph tidak diperbarui. **Tidak ada source, konfigurasi AWS, atau data yang saya ubah pada pemeriksaan ini.**

Belum diuji: upload/delete nyata dari setiap halaman dan status aktivasi seluruh menu. Risiko yang sudah terlihat adalah uploader yang masih memakai `public-read` serta Delete News yang dapat melaporkan sukses walaupun objek S3 gagal dihapus.

Ok sekarang kan yang manage popup sudah kamu perbaiki sekarang sisanya yang upload dan delete ke AWS S3 kamu check apakah seperti manage popup, menurut saya pasti ada yang error juga seperti manage popup, kalau ada langsung kamu perbaiki yah

**Benar, ada beberapa masalah lain. Perbaikan kode upload dan penanganan delete sudah saya terapkan serta uji. Namun, delete nyata di AWS masih tertahan oleh izin akun AWS—penyebabnya sekarang sudah terkonfirmasi.**

| Bagian | Masalah yang ditemukan | Perbaikan dan hasil |
|---|---|---|
| **News → gambar SEO/metatag** | Masih memakai `public-read`; penyimpanan dapat melaporkan sukses meskipun upload gagal. | Diganti ke `private`. Metadata baru disimpan setelah upload berhasil. **Upload nyata dan akses gambar melalui URL aset berhasil HTTP 200.** |
| **Section Content → gambar halaman** | Memakai helper `public-read` yang sama dengan penyebab kegagalan Popup. | Helper diperbaiki menjadi `private`. **Upload nyata dan akses gambar berhasil HTTP 200.** |
| **Section Content → logo Footer** | Masih memakai `public-read`. | Mengikuti perbaikan helper bersama. **Upload nyata dan akses gambar berhasil HTTP 200.** |
| **Section Content → video** | Field MP4 diarahkan ke helper yang hanya menerima gambar dan mengonversi ke WebP. | MP4 sekarang memiliki jalur upload tersendiri, mempertahankan isi video, memakai MIME `video/mp4`, dan mengikuti batas ukuran video yang sudah digunakan controller. Pengujian terisolasi lulus. |
| **News → Delete Post** | Tidak memeriksa hasil delete S3; artikel dapat dihapus dari database dan UI melaporkan sukses walaupun file S3 gagal dihapus. | Sekarang memeriksa hasil delete setiap objek. **Jika ada kegagalan, record artikel tidak dihapus dan pesan kegagalan ditampilkan.** |
| **Pre-book → Manage Files → Delete** | Penolakan delete dari S3 hanya ditampilkan sebagai pesan umum. | Sekarang menjelaskan kegagalan delete dan kebutuhan pemeriksaan izin AWS. Pengujian membuktikan metadata file tetap dipertahankan saat delete gagal. |
| **Wrapper S3 dan uploader teknis `/manage`** | Default/parameter upload tertentu masih memakai `public-read`. | Diselaraskan ke `private`. Wrapper juga mengirim `ContentType` sesuai file. Utilitas transfer massal tidak saya jalankan. |

**Untuk delete, kendala yang tersisa berada di AWS.** Pengujian pada objek QA menghasilkan:

```text
AccessDenied — HTTP 403
Tidak ada identity-based policy yang mengizinkan s3:DeleteObject.
```

[Kredensial disamarkan]

Saya sudah menyiapkan [draft policy delete terbatas](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/project-artifacts/s3-upload-delete-20261015/proposed-delete-policy.json), khusus untuk operasi delete yang memang ada di CMS:

- `assets.mgmotor.id/contents/userfiles/news/*`
- `assets.mgmotor.id/contents/userfiles/metatag/articles/*`
- `assets.mgmotor.id/contents/userfiles/prebook/*`

Policy tersebut hanya menambahkan **`s3:DeleteObject`**, tanpa izin mengubah bucket policy atau akses ke seluruh bucket. **Belum diterapkan.**

Hasil verifikasi keseluruhan:

- **36 pemeriksaan terisolasi/regresi lulus**, termasuk upload gagal, SEO tanpa gambar baru, delete gagal, delete sukses simulasi, dan perlindungan metadata Pre-book.
- Pemeriksaan sintaks **6 file PHP lulus**.
- `git diff --check` lulus.
- **3 jalur upload nyata berhasil**, disertai pemeriksaan URL aset HTTP 200.
- Tidak ada perubahan database CMS aktif atau penghapusan aset aktif selama pengujian.

Enam file yang diubah:

- [Helper upload bersama](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/application/common/function.php:3827)
- [Wrapper S3](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/application/libraries/Aruna_S3.php:28)
- [Penyimpanan file Pre-book](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/application/libraries/Prebook_store.php:86)
- [Controller News](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/modules/manage_news/manage_news.php:456)
- [Controller Manage Pre-book](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/modules/manage_prebook/manage_prebook.php:84)
- [Uploader teknis Manage](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/modules/manage/manage.php:85)

[Backup sebelum perubahan](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/project-artifacts/s3-upload-delete-20261015/backups) dan [laporan verifikasi](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/project-artifacts/s3-upload-delete-20261015/verification.json) sudah tersimpan. Pemeriksaan memakai memori C yang relevan karena drive E tidak tersedia, node Graphify lokal, lalu source aktif. Graphify tidak diperbarui.

**Apakah Anda menyetujui penerapan draft policy tersebut ke akun IAM `s3-access`, agar akun aplikasi dapat menghapus objek hanya pada tiga folder di atas?** Saya meminta persetujuan khusus karena langkah berikutnya menambah hak penghapusan permanen di AWS, di luar perubahan source lokal.

Belum diuji: tombol upload/delete dari browser Anda, pemutaran MP4 penuh, dan transfer massal. Delete beberapa objek S3 tidak bersifat atomik; jika objek awal berhasil dihapus lalu objek berikutnya gagal, objek yang sudah terhapus tidak otomatis kembali.
Jadi perbaikan yang dilakukan hanya bisa untuk upload saja, untuk yang delete nggak bisa karena dari AWS S3nya langsung belum ada izin untuk bisa hapus filenya langsung?

**Ya, betul. Upload sudah diperbaiki dan berhasil diuji. Delete file secara fisik di S3 masih ditolak karena akun AWS yang dipakai aplikasi belum memiliki izin `s3:DeleteObject` untuk objek yang diuji.**

Ada dua bagian yang perlu dibedakan:

| Bagian | Status sekarang |
|---|---|
| **Upload ke S3** | Sudah diperbaiki. Pengujian nyata upload gambar SEO News, gambar halaman, dan logo Footer berhasil. |
| **Penanganan delete di aplikasi** | Sudah diperbaiki. Aplikasi memeriksa kegagalan dari S3, menampilkan pesan gagal, dan mempertahankan record database ketika delete ditolak. |
| **Penghapusan file di S3** | **Belum bisa**, sampai izin delete diberikan kepada akun IAM `s3-access`. |

Jadi, sebelumnya **News bisa terlihat berhasil dihapus dari CMS padahal file masih tertinggal di S3**. Sekarang, jika AWS menolak penghapusan file, **artikel tidak ikut dihapus dari database dan aplikasi tidak melaporkan sukses**.

Agar delete benar-benar berjalan, akun `s3-access` perlu diberi izin `s3:DeleteObject` pada folder yang diperlukan. Draft policy terbatas sudah saya siapkan, tetapi **belum diterapkan ke AWS**.

Yang belum terverifikasi adalah delete nyata setelah izin ditambahkan; setelah itu tetap perlu diuji ulang.
Coba lagi dah untuk delete file ke AWS S3 sudah bisa belum?

**Ya, sekarang delete ke AWS S3 sudah bisa.** Saya baru saja menguji penghapusan **empat objek QA dari pengujian sebelumnya**, dan semuanya berhasil.

| Folder yang diuji | Sebelum delete | Respons delete | Setelah delete |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gambar SEO News — `metatag/articles` | File tersedia, HTTP 200 | **HTTP 204 — berhasil** | HTTP 404; key tidak ditemukan |
| Gambar halaman — `content_inpages/images` | File tersedia, HTTP 200 | **HTTP 204 — berhasil** | HTTP 404; key tidak ditemukan |
| Logo Footer — `logo` | File tersedia, HTTP 200 | **HTTP 204 — berhasil** | HTTP 404; key tidak ditemukan |
| Flyer QA Pre-book — `prebook/qa` | File tersedia, HTTP 200 | **HTTP 204 — berhasil** | HTTP 404; key tidak ditemukan |

Jadi, penolakan **`AccessDenied / 403` yang sebelumnya terjadi sudah tidak muncul pada keempat jalur tersebut**. Saya juga mengecek daftar objek S3 untuk memastikan key yang dihapus sudah tidak tercantum.

Semua yang dihapus adalah **file QA milik pengujian**, bukan banner, artikel, logo, atau flyer aktif. Hasil pemeriksaan tersimpan di [folder verifikasi delete](D:/Laragon/www/newmg/project-artifacts/s3-delete-recheck-20261015).

Belum diuji ulang: klik Delete dari browser CMS dan folder gambar utama News (`news/`). Keberhasilan di atas membuktikan izin delete pada folder yang diuji, bukan otomatis seluruh isi bucket.
Ok berarti proses read, upload dan delete sudah aman yah permissionnya ke AWS S3?

**Ya, untuk operasi dan folder yang sudah kita uji, permission AWS S3 sekarang sudah berfungsi: read, upload, dan delete berhasil.**

| Operasi | Bukti pengujian |
|---|---|
| **Read** | Aplikasi berhasil membaca S3; gambar hasil upload dapat diakses melalui URL aset dengan **HTTP 200**. |
| **Upload** | Upload Popup web/mobile, gambar SEO News, gambar halaman, dan logo Footer berhasil menggunakan ACL `private`. |
| **Delete** | Empat objek QA pada folder SEO News, gambar halaman, logo, dan Pre-book berhasil dihapus dengan **HTTP 204**. Setelahnya, objek tidak lagi ditemukan. |

Jadi, **hambatan permission yang sebelumnya kita temukan sudah teratasi pada jalur tersebut**. Aplikasi juga sudah memeriksa kegagalan upload/delete agar tidak melaporkan sukses ketika operasi S3 gagal.

# Diagnosed and repaired the NEWMG S3 upload failures, repaired Codex Windows sandbox access, audited S3 delete behavior, and documented remaining IAM/browser limitations

Rollout context: Work occurred primarily in `D:\Laragon\www\newmg` on Windows PowerShell. The user initially reported that Manage Popup failed with “Gagal upload file utama ke S3,” then asked to repair the execution environment, fix the upload, inventory other S3 upload/delete paths, repair related failures, re-test deletion, and audit whether AWS permissions were sufficiently scoped. The user repeatedly emphasized backup-first changes, Indonesian explanations, preserving active content, and never deleting objects still in use.

## Task 1: Restore Codex Windows sandbox access

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- When the first generic troubleshooting path was blocked, the user asked “Coba kamu perbaiki dulu” and later explicitly authorized execution of the proposed owner change -> for future Windows access failures, diagnose the concrete service/ACL boundary first, then request or use explicit approval for the exact target and recipient before persistent permission changes.
- The user accepted a narrowly scoped change only for `D:\Laragon\www\newmg` and `.git`, without recursion -> preserve this conservative scope and avoid broad ACL changes, sandbox disabling, or `Everyone: Full Control`.

Key steps:

- Initial normal sandbox commands repeatedly failed with `helper_unknown_error: setup refresh had errors`.
- Latest sandbox log identified the actual cause: write ACE update failed on `D:\Laragon\www\newmg`; deny ACE update failed on `D:\Laragon\www\newmg\.git`.
- The two directories were owned by a SID from a different Windows account than the current `ANDHIKA_ARUNIKA\aruna` account. `CodexSandboxService.OpenAI.Codex` runs as `LocalSystem`.
- Created a backup under `project-artifacts\sandbox-repair-20261015-0935` containing security descriptors and the repair script. With explicit user authorization, changed ownership only on the two directories, non-recursively, while checking that the original DACL remained unchanged.
- After the repair, Codex sandbox setup completed with `errors=[]`, `setup binary completed`, and `setup_error.json` was absent. Normal shell execution resumed.

Reusable knowledge:

- For this machine, the failure was project-root ACL ownership, distinct from the earlier `.codex\.sandbox-bin` helper-lock issue. Do not conflate the two incidents.
- The repair artifact is `D:\Laragon\www\newmg\project-artifacts\sandbox-repair-20261015-0935`.

References:

- Exact log errors: `write ACE failed on D:\Laragon\www\newmg: open ACL target for update` and `deny ACE failed on D:\Laragon\www\newmg\.git: open deny ACL target for update`.
- Verification log ended with `setup refresh: processed 3 write roots ... errors=[]` and `setup binary completed`.

## Task 2: Diagnose and repair Manage Popup S3 upload

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user asked to fix the reported error directly and then asked whether uploading a replacement popup banner was safe -> future agents should verify both the underlying helper and the user-visible upload path before claiming completion, while clearly stating whether active records were changed.
- The user wanted the smallest safe repair and accepted backup-first source changes -> keep the patch surgical and preserve the existing bucket policy/configuration unless evidence requires otherwise.

Key steps:

- Traced `modules/manage_popup/manage_popup.php` to shared helper `process_upload_article_s3()` in `application/common/function.php`.
- Reproduced the failure with a real S3 probe: `public-read` returned `AccessDenied` with `BlockPublicAcls`; the same object uploaded with `private` returned HTTP 200 and could be fetched through the asset URL with identical bytes.
- Changed the three ACL values in `process_upload_article_s3()`—main image and two thumbnails—from `public-read` to `private`.
- Verified real helper behavior for both web and mobile: JPEG, including a filename ending in `.jpg.jpeg`, was converted to WebP, uploaded to S3, and retrieved from the asset URL with HTTP 200.
- No active Popup record was saved or published during testing.

Reusable knowledge:

- Bucket-level `BlockPublicAcls` rejects canned `public-read`; private objects remain usable through the application’s asset URL path in the tested configuration.
- Backup: `project-artifacts\popup-s3-20261015\function.php.bak_20261015_popup_s3`.
- Verification: `project-artifacts\popup-s3-20261015\verification.json`.

References:

- Source: `application/common/function.php`, `process_upload_article_s3()` around lines 4073–4220.
- Error evidence: `BlockPublicAcls`, `AccessDenied`.
- Validation: PHP lint, `git diff --check`, real web/mobile helper upload and retrieval, and 13 upload-integrity regression checks passed.

## Task 3: Inventory and repair other S3 upload/delete paths

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user asked for a complete list of pages that upload/delete to S3 and then requested that similar failures be fixed immediately -> future audits should inspect shared helpers and all callers, not stop after the first page works.
- The user specifically warned not to delete active objects -> all live delete tests in this rollout used exact keys for agent-created QA objects; no wildcard, prefix-wide, active CMS record, or database delete was used.

Key steps:

- Found active S3 upload/delete paths in Manage News, Section Content, Pre-book, Popup, and technical Manage utilities. Header, Dropdown, Appearance, and MG Models primarily use local upload paths in the active source inspected.
- Changed shared `process_upload_s3()` from `public-read` to `private`, added upload-error validation, and kept image conversion behavior for image folders.
- Added an explicit MP4 path for `content_inpages/videos`: preserves original bytes, uses `video/mp4`, private ACL, and the existing 50,000 KiB boundary; MP4 is no longer passed through image-to-WebP conversion.
- Updated `Aruna_S3::putObject()` default ACL to `private`, opens files in binary mode, and sends `ContentType` from `mime_content_type()`. Technical Manage upload examples were aligned to private ACL.
- Updated News SEO create/edit so the image upload succeeds before metadata is inserted/updated; failed upload now leaves the database unchanged and returns a failure message.
- Updated News `deletepost()` to verify every S3 delete before deleting article/metatag records. If any delete fails, the article remains and the user receives an actionable failure message. This is not a true multi-object transaction: earlier successful deletes cannot be rolled back if a later one fails.
- Improved Pre-book delete failure handling with error code `1002` and a message that preserves active metadata when S3 deletion fails.

Validation:

- 36 isolated/regression checks passed, including upload failure preservation, News SEO create/edit behavior, News delete success/failure simulation, Pre-book delete rollback behavior, MP4 validation, MIME rejection, private ACL checks, and SDK command checks.
- Six PHP files passed lint and `git diff --check` passed.
- Real uploads for `metatag/articles`, `content_inpages/images`, and `logo` returned HTTP 200 and asset retrieval returned HTTP 200.

References:

- Modified files: `application/common/function.php`, `application/libraries/Aruna_S3.php`, `application/libraries/Prebook_store.php`, `modules/manage/manage.php`, `modules/manage_news/manage_news.php`, `modules/manage_prebook/manage_prebook.php`.
- Backup directory: `project-artifacts\s3-upload-delete-20261015\backups`.
- Tests and reports: `upload-integrity.cjs`, `helper-tests.php`, `news-tests.cjs`, `prebook-tests.php`, `sdk-tests.php`, `verification.json`.

## Task 4: Re-test AWS delete and audit permission scope

Outcome: partial

Key steps:

[Kredensial disamarkan]
- On a later explicit user request, re-tested only four exact QA keys created during prior testing: SEO image, Content In Pages image, footer logo, and Pre-book QA flyer. Each was confirmed present with HTTP 200, deleted with HTTP 204, then confirmed absent with HTTP 404 and absent from an exact-prefix listing.
- Created and deleted a separate exact-key News QA object under `contents/userfiles/news/qa/`; upload returned 200, read returned 200, delete returned 204, post-delete HEAD returned 404, and remaining exact-key count was zero.
- Read-only IAM and bucket-policy audit calls all returned `AccessDenied`: IAM user/policy/group reads and S3 bucket policy, Public Access Block, ACL, Object Ownership, versioning, and encryption reads. Therefore operation success is verified for tested prefixes, but least-privilege scope is not proven.
- A draft policy was prepared but not applied: only `s3:DeleteObject` for `assets.mgmotor.id/contents/userfiles/{news,metatag/articles,prebook}/*`.

Failures and how to do differently:

- Do not infer least privilege from successful upload/read/delete. Request read-only policy JSON from an administrator or AWS Console, without requesting access keys/secrets.
- Do not test deletion on active objects. Continue using exact, agent-created QA keys and verify before/after state.
- Do not claim full browser E2E until an authenticated session is available.

Reusable knowledge:

[Kredensial disamarkan]
- The app can now perform tested read/upload/delete operations, but policy boundaries remain unknown.
- Drive `E:\AI\Memories` was unavailable; the durable conversation note was saved only on C: at `C:\Users\aruna\.codex\memories\extensions\ad_hoc\notes\20261015-132158-newmg-sandbox-s3-upload-delete-permission-audit.md`.

Outcome: success

# Incremental Graphify refresh completed for NEWMG with historical-source pruning and verification

Rollout context: The user asked in Indonesian, “Update data graphifynya dong” while working in `D:\Laragon\www\newmg`. The existing Graphify output was dated 12 October 2026. The agent used the local Graphify skill and refreshed the graph against the active source tree, preserving backups and avoiding application/database mutations.

## Task 1: Incrementally update the NEWMG Graphify data graph

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user asked for the project’s Graphify data to be updated rather than requesting application-code changes. Future agents should treat this as a graph/artifact maintenance task and avoid modifying runtime source, database, deployment, or Git history unless explicitly requested.
- The agent proactively excluded backup/old/historical source entries from the graph while explicitly preserving the original files. This distinction is important for similar maintenance requests: remove stale sources from graph data, not from the working tree.
- The final response clearly separated local verification from runtime/deployment proof, noting that browser/runtime behavior and AWS/E2E behavior were not tested. Preserve this distinction in future reports.

Key steps:

- Read the Graphify skill and existing NEWMG memory context. Existing outputs were present in `graphify-out`; the prior graph contained 3,173 nodes and 3,959 edges and included many files with `backup`/`old` naming.
- Created a backup and staged verification area under `project-artifacts/graphify-update-20261015` before changing Graphify outputs.
- Used the installed interpreter at `C:\Users\aruna\AppData\Roaming\uv\tools\graphifyy\Scripts\python.exe` and a custom offline incremental update script.
- Recomputed the active source set, excluded sensitive/config-like files and historical names, re-extracted changed code files, merged the fresh extraction into the existing graph, and added CSS/HTML as metadata-only nodes.
- Re-extracted 29 changed source files, retained 560 source files in the manifest, represented 103 CSS/HTML files as metadata, and pruned 52 historical/deleted graph sources. The original files were not deleted.
- Regenerated `graph.json`, `GRAPH_REPORT.md`, `graph.html`, manifests, labels, extraction, analysis, and related Graphify artifacts.
- Moved an accidentally nested cache directory from `graphify-out/graphify-out` into `project-artifacts/graphify-update-20261015/extraction-cache` and formatted the generated JSON artifacts.
- Ran a Graphify query for `Prebook_otp Prebook_store manage_prebook`; it found 75 nodes, including `Prebook_store`, `prebook`, `.sendOTPCode()`, `.otpStatus()`, `.requireCaptcha()`, `.upload()`, and `.deleteFile()`.
- Final validation confirmed current manifest hashes, unique node IDs, valid link endpoints, unchanged source hashes during the update, local/offline visualization, and Git changes limited to `graphify-out`.

Failures and how to do differently:

- Initial ordinary terminal invocations failed with `helper_unknown_error: setup refresh had errors`; retrying with elevated local access allowed the required reads and update script to run.
- A first update script over-broadly included dependencies/plugins and initially produced an unintended nested `graphify-out/graphify-out` cache. The scope was narrowed, the cache was moved into the project artifact area, and final Git/status validation was rerun.
- Six changed code files yielded no symbols and were represented only as file-level nodes; the final report correctly disclosed this limitation. Future agents should not claim symbol-level coverage for such files without additional parser support.
- The Graphify query modified `graphify-out/cache/last_query_stamp`, and an untracked nested output directory appeared before cleanup. Always inspect `git status --short` after queries and remove or relocate accidental nested output before reporting completion.
- The generated report initially said `663 files · ~0 words`; it was corrected to `word count not measured (incremental update)` rather than presenting zero as a meaningful corpus word count.

Reusable knowledge:

- Current Graphify output after the successful update: 2,836 nodes, 3,577 relations, 626 communities; 3,018 links are `EXTRACTED` and 559 are `INFERRED`.
- The graph size decreased from 3,173 to 2,836 nodes because 52 stale/historical sources were pruned; this is intentional and does not mean source files were deleted.
- Important changed files included `application/libraries/Prebook_otp.php`, `Prebook_captcha.php`, `Prebook_otp_limit.php`, `Prebook_store.php`, `Aruna_S3.php`, `assets/js/prebook.js`, `assets/js/manage-prebook.js`, `modules/prebook/prebook.php`, `modules/manage_prebook/manage_prebook.php`, its config/menu/view files, and related route/template files.
- Graphify’s installed Python interpreter is `C:\Users\aruna\AppData\Roaming\uv\tools\graphifyy\Scripts\python.exe`; the project’s `.graphify_python` points to the same interpreter.
- `graphify-out/graph.json` has the node-link shape with `directed`, `multigraph`, `graph`, `nodes`, `links`, and `hyperedges`; the resulting graph had 2,836 nodes and 3,577 links.
- The update was local and offline: no external LLM tokens were used, no application/database mutation occurred, and no commit or push occurred.

messages.text: ChatGPT di CMS kitan sudah ada manage header navigation yah, tapi menurut saya sekarang masih kurang bagus UI UX halamannya termasuk previewnya dan UI UX form settingsnya, saya ingin revamp total, bisa kamu buatkan design revamp prototypenya disini?

Sudah saya buat **prototipe revamp interaktif** yang bisa Anda coba langsung di bawah.

Konsepnya: **preview sebagai area utama, settings di panel kanan**, dengan aksen merah Phoenix yang lebih terkontrol. Form dibagi menjadi **Layout, Appearance, dan Behavior** supaya pengaturan ukuran, warna, dan perilaku scroll lebih mudah ditemukan.

visualize{"path":"D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261015-header-navigation-revamp/header-navigation.html","mode":"wide"}

Yang bisa Anda coba:

- **Desktop / Tablet / Mobile** — tinggi, padding, dan radius disimpan terpisah untuk setiap perangkat.
- **Layout** — ubah lebar header, posisi logo, ukuran, dan jaraknya.
- **Appearance** — ubah background, warna teks, warna menu aktif/hover, serta bayangan.
- **Behavior** — coba sticky, static, sembunyikan saat scroll, dan background awal transparan melalui tombol **Atas / Setelah scroll**.

# Header Navigation UI/UX revamp progressed from prototype to production styling, with a documented image-loading caveat

Rollout context: The user wanted a total UI/UX revamp of Phoenix CMS's Manage Header Navigation page, including the editor layout, live preview, settings form, and preview behavior. Work occurred in `D:\Laragon\www\laravel-13-phoenix` using PowerShell, with existing uncommitted Article/template changes that had to be preserved.

## Task 1: Inspect existing Header Navigation CMS and create a revamp prototype

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user initially asked for a "revamp total" covering the page UI/UX, preview, and settings form. This indicates that future design work should address the complete editing workflow, not just recolor or rearrange one panel.
- The user later clarified: "Untuk semua opsi settingnya pakai yang sekarang ada di CMS jadi lengkap prototypenya". Future prototypes must preserve every currently supported CMS option and should be derived from the active Blade/JS/normalizer rather than an abbreviated mockup.
- The user rejected an early preview direction as not looking like the previous design and repeatedly asked for the preview itself to be redone. Future changes should preserve the approved visual language of the preview while changing only the requested control behavior.
- The user asked for direct execution rather than discussion: "Ok langsung ubah dong previewnya" and later "Ok langsung kamu eksekusi implement ke sidebarnya". For similarly concrete UI requests, implement the change and verify it instead of stopping at a proposal.

Key steps:

- Existing source and historical handoffs were inspected. Relevant production anchors were identified as `resources/views/awesome_admin/header_navigation/awesome_admin_header_navigation.blade.php`, `public/assets/css/awesome-admin-header-navigation.css`, `public/assets/js/awesome-admin-header-navigation.js`, and `tests/Feature/HeaderNavigationSettingsTest.php`.
- Graphify was queried for `header navigation settings preview` and `Awesome_Admin_Header_Navigation_Controller`; the normalizer and active renderer were inspected.
- The existing CMS was found to support layout, responsive sizing, colors/state colors, shadows, transparency, scroll behavior, linked four-side controls, Leaf link shape/direction, unit selectors, JSON/config preview, and device previews.
- A first prototype was created under `project-artifacts/mockups/20261015-header-navigation-revamp/header-navigation.html` with a preview-dominant workspace, settings tabs, desktop/tablet/mobile controls, live style updates, scroll simulation, and session-only draft save/discard behavior.
- The first prototype was verified with headless Chrome at widths 1024, 768, 430, and 320; primary interactions passed, no page errors occurred, and no horizontal overflow was detected.

Reusable knowledge:

- Production Header Navigation already has a full implementation including controller, request, normalizer, persistence, routes, menu loading, dropdown arrow integration, and tests. A prototype should mirror that structure and not invent a simplified settings model.
- The production preview uses virtual viewports Desktop `1440x900`, Tablet `820x1180`, and Mobile `430x932`, with proportional fitting and a minimum fit historically recorded at 65%.
- The active backend normalizer is `app/Support/FrontendHeaderNavigationConfigNormalizer.php`; it whitelists units (`px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `pt`), devices, positions, behavior values, containers, link shapes, leaf directions, and transparent color modes.

Failures and how to do differently:

- Initial shell/tool attempts failed because the Windows sandbox helper exited with `helper_unknown_error`; using `require_escalated` allowed the agent to read skills and inspect the project. Future Windows runs should pivot quickly to the permitted elevated executor when the sandbox cannot create a process.
- The initial prototype omitted many CMS options. The user explicitly corrected this, so future UI prototypes must enumerate controls from the Blade and normalizer first and compare every control/option before calling the prototype complete.

References:

- Prototype: `project-artifacts/mockups/20261015-header-navigation-revamp/header-navigation.html`
- Initial prototype QA: `project-artifacts/mockups/20261015-header-navigation-revamp/check.mjs`
- Browser verification output: `PASS: interactions, responsive layout, zero page errors`
- Existing production controller: `app/Http/Controllers/Web/Awesome_Admin/Awesome_Admin_Header_Navigation_Controller.php`
- Existing normalizer: `app/Support/FrontendHeaderNavigationConfigNormalizer.php`

## Task 2: Expand the prototype to exact CMS option parity

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user required all existing settings, not a redesign that drops advanced controls. Future implementation should treat source parity as an acceptance criterion.
- The user wanted responsive and conditional behaviors to be represented in the preview, including linked/unlinked values, scroll state, transparency, and shadow configuration.

Key steps:

- A source-derived build script generated the complete prototype from the current Blade, JS, and CSS while removing network calls for offline visualization use.
- The generated artifact contained 50 input/select controls and 7 segmented control groups, with a `cms-parity.json` manifest recording the source paths and SHA-256 hashes.
- Controls included active state, device, layout positions, container mode, height/unit, four responsive box groups, colors and state colors, linked borders, shadow values and units, transparency controls, scroll animation, scroll simulation, link shape, leaf direction, and configuration preview.
- Headless Chrome verification compared every control ID and select option against the Blade source, exercised responsive overrides, linked/unlinked box values, Leaf direction, border linking, shadow/inset, behavior dependencies, scroll presets, reset, save/discard, mobile menu, multiple viewport widths, zero page errors, and zero network requests.
- One mobile-menu issue was found when the selected layout did not render a hamburger; the build was corrected to inject the hamburger for non-desktop preview modes, then rerun successfully.

Reusable knowledge:

- Final prototype parity evidence: `Built complete prototype: 50 CMS inputs/selects, 7 segmented groups` followed by `PASS: 50 CMS inputs/selects, 7 option groups, responsive and conditional interactions, zero requests/errors.`
- The prototype is a design artifact only; it uses sample menus and session-only draft behavior and must not be confused with authenticated CMS persistence.
- Backups were created before prototype revisions under `project-artifacts/mockups/20261015-header-navigation-revamp/backups/`.

Failures and how to do differently:

- A first complete-prototype test timed out looking for `.hamburger` in a mobile layout. The issue was a layout-specific renderer path, not a missing CMS option. Future responsive tests should exercise every combination that affects conditional markup, not only the default logo/menu arrangement.

- Final QA result: `project-artifacts/mockups/20261015-header-navigation-revamp/qa/complete/result.json`

## Task 3: Implement the approved horizontal stepper/unit-control design in the production sidebar

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

messages.text:
ChatGPT coba perbaiki SSD Portable di drive E saya dong, perasaan kemarin pas dilepas sudah safely statusnya, masa sekarang ini saya colok malah ada notice dipojok kanan bawah

<image name=[Image #1] path="C:\Users\aruna\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-clipboard-619d7ea1-f837-4b35-a2a6-9a4d30cf7a82.png">

</image>
ChatGPT coba perbaiki SSD Portable di drive E saya dong, perasaan kemarin pas dilepas sudah safely statusnya, masa sekarang ini saya colok malah ada notice dipojok kanan bawah

**Notifikasinya memang menunjukkan masalah nyata pada drive E:, tetapi belum bisa disimpulkan SSD-nya rusak secara fisik.** Saya sudah memeriksa kondisinya, dan perbaikannya perlu didahului pengamanan data karena ditemukan gangguan pembacaan.

Hasil pemeriksaan terbaru:

| Pemeriksaan | Hasil |
|---|---|
| Perangkat | Transcend **ESD310C TS256GESD310C**, USB, sekitar 256 GB |
| Volume | **Andhika G (E:)**, exFAT |
| Status sistem file | **Warning — Full Repair Needed** |
| Penanda volume | **Dirty** |
| Pemeriksaan awal CHKDSK | **“A media error has been detected. Bad sectors may be present on the volume.”** |
| Catatan Windows | Pembacaan **Disk 1** diulang (*I/O retry*, Event 153) dan koneksi perangkat di-reset (*UASPStor*, Event 129) |

Pemeriksaan tidak menunjukkan kemajuan setelah awal pemindaian, sehingga **saya hentikan pemeriksaan tanpa menjalankan perbaikan yang mengubah sistem file**. Pesan “bad sectors may be present” masih berupa indikasi, belum hasil konfirmasi bad sector.

Soal kemarin sudah *Safely Remove*: **itu tidak berarti kamu salah melepas SSD.** Gangguan port/koneksi USB, daya, atau perangkatnya sendiri masih bisa terjadi saat dipasang kembali. Bukti saat ini belum cukup untuk menentukan penyebab pastinya. Saya juga membaca memori perbaikan Juni dan Juli di `E:\AI\Memories`; masalah serupa pernah terjadi, tetapi hasil sehat saat itu tidak membuktikan kondisi sekarang.

**Apakah data penting di E: sudah punya backup di tempat lain?** Kalau belum, sebutkan folder paling penting dan lokasi tujuan backup di C: atau D:. Jawaban ini diperlukan karena perbaikan exFAT mengubah metadata sistem file, sedangkan drive saat ini sudah menunjukkan error pembacaan. Untuk sementara, hindari menyalin data baru ke E: atau memformatnya.

Belum dilakukan: repair, format, atau perubahan file; pemeriksaan sistem file tidak selesai dan kesehatan fisik SSD belum terverifikasi. Risiko utama saat ini adalah data sulit dibaca jika gangguan berlanjut.
Jangan diformat coba perbaiki

**Tidak saya format. Perbaikan belum bisa berjalan karena volume E: sekarang tidak terbaca dengan normal.**

Pemeriksaan terbaru menunjukkan:

- Perangkat SSD **Transcend ESD310C 256 GB** masih terdeteksi.
- Huruf **E:** masih tercatat, tetapi nama volume, sistem file, dan kapasitasnya tidak terbaca.
- Windows kembali mencatat **reset koneksi perangkat USB**. Ini konsisten dengan gangguan pembacaan sebelumnya.

Saya menghentikan percobaan tadi ketika pemeriksaan awal tidak bisa menemukan volume E:, sebelum ada hasil perbaikan CHKDSK.

Supaya bisa dilanjutkan, lakukan ini dulu:

1. Tutup File Explorer atau aplikasi yang sedang memakai E:.
2. Coba **Eject / Safely Remove**. Jika gagal karena perangkat tidak merespons, matikan Windows sepenuhnya sebelum mencabut SSD.
3. Sambungkan SSD kembali langsung ke port USB lain di laptop, tanpa hub jika sebelumnya memakai hub.
4. Kalau muncul tawaran **Format disk**, pilih **Cancel**.

Setelah tersambung kembali, balas **“sudah dicolok ulang”**. Saya akan periksa identitas dan keterbacaan volumenya, kemudian lanjutkan perbaikan tanpa format sesuai izinmu.

**Belum terverifikasi:** perbaikan sistem file dan kesehatan fisik SSD. Gangguan baca/reset USB masih menjadi risiko terhadap data.
Coba lagi dah

**Perbaikan sistem file E: berhasil selesai tanpa format.** Windows sekarang sudah menghapus status *Full Repair Needed*.

Hasil verifikasi setelah menjalankan `chkdsk E: /f`:

| Pemeriksaan | Hasil terbaru |
|---|---|
| Drive | **Andhika G (E:)**, exFAT |
| Status volume | **Healthy** |
| Status operasional | **OK** |
| Dirty flag | **NOT Dirty** |
| Akses daftar folder utama | Berhasil dibaca |
| Hasil CHKDSK | **“Windows has made corrections to the file system.”** |

**Namun, ada temuan yang perlu kamu tahu:** selama pemeriksaan, Windows mencatat beberapa **Disk Event 7 — “has a bad block”** pada SSD ini. CHKDSK juga melaporkan menemukan dan menguji sektor bermasalah, meskipun ringkasan akhirnya mencantumkan **0 KB in bad sectors**. Jadi, status sistem file sudah pulih, tetapi **saya belum bisa menyatakan perangkat SSD-nya sepenuhnya sehat**.

Saran saya sekarang, **salin data penting dari E: ke drive lain terlebih dahulu** selagi bisa dibaca. Notifikasi akibat status Dirty sudah ditangani, tetapi bila gangguan baca muncul kembali, penyebab perangkat atau koneksi USB masih perlu diperiksa.

Belum diperiksa: keutuhan isi setiap file dan apakah notifikasi muncul lagi setelah eject lalu colok ulang. Risiko yang masih ada adalah error pembacaan berulang, berdasarkan catatan *bad block* saat perbaikan.

# Perbaikan filesystem SSD portable E: selesai tanpa format, tetapi indikasi masalah perangkat/koneksi masih ada

Rollout context: Pengguna meminta perbaikan SSD portable di drive E: setelah Windows menampilkan notifikasi perbaikan, sambil menegaskan agar drive tidak diformat. Lingkungan Windows PowerShell, cwd `C:\Users\aruna\Documents\Codex\2026-10-16\chatgpt-coba-perbaiki-ssd-portable-di`.

## Task 1: Mendiagnosis dan memperbaiki SSD portable E:

Outcome: success untuk perbaikan filesystem; uncertain/partial untuk kesehatan fisik SSD.

Preference signals:

- Ketika diberi pilihan antara backup/diagnosis dan perubahan filesystem, pengguna secara eksplisit berkata: "Jangan diformat coba perbaiki" -> pada kasus serupa, jangan pernah menawarkan atau menjalankan format sebagai langkah perbaikan default; gunakan repair non-format dan jelaskan risikonya.
- Setelah percobaan pertama tidak berjalan karena volume menghilang, pengguna meminta: "Coba lagi dah" -> pengguna bersedia mengulang pemeriksaan/perbaikan ketika drive kembali terbaca, dan mengharapkan agen melanjutkan tindakan langsung dengan tetap mempertahankan batasan tanpa format.
- Pengguna menginginkan tindakan praktis terhadap perangkatnya, tetapi tetap perlu diberi status proses dan hasil verifikasi sebelum dinyatakan selesai; agen beberapa kali menunggu hasil final CHKDSK alih-alih menganggap progres 100% sebagai sukses.

Key steps:

- Pemeriksaan awal dengan `Get-Volume`, `Get-Partition`, dan `fsutil dirty query E:` memerlukan akses administrator; tanpa elevation muncul `Access denied`/`Error 5`.
- Setelah elevation, drive teridentifikasi sebagai Transcend `ESD310C TS256GESD310C`, USB, sekitar 256 GB; volume `Andhika G (E:)`, exFAT, `HealthStatus: Warning`, `OperationalStatus: Full Repair Needed`, dan `Volume - E: is Dirty`.
- Pemeriksaan `chkdsk E:` tanpa repair menemukan: `A media error has been detected. Bad sectors may be present on the volume.` Event log juga menunjukkan Disk Event 153 (I/O retry) dan UASPStor Event 129 (device reset pada `RaidPort2`).
- Percobaan awal `chkdsk E: /f` gagal memulai karena volume E: sempat kehilangan metadata/kemampuan mount; perangkat fisiknya tetap terlihat sebagai Disk 1, tetapi filesystem/kapasitas logical disk tidak terbaca. Agen menghentikan percobaan dan meminta reconnect langsung ke port USB lain tanpa format.
- Setelah pengguna meminta mencoba lagi, E: kembali terbaca sebagai `Andhika G`, exFAT, 256 GB. `chkdsk E: /f` dijalankan dengan elevation, tanpa format. Proses lama dan sempat tampak 100% pada satu tahap, tetapi tetap ditunggu sampai laporan akhir.
- Laporan final CHKDSK menyatakan `Windows has made corrections to the file system.`, `No further action is required.`, dan ringkasan mencantumkan `0 KB in bad sectors`.
- Verifikasi pascaperbaikan berhasil: volume `Healthy`, `OperationalStatus: OK`, `Volume - E: is NOT Dirty`, dan daftar folder utama dapat dibaca (12 entries).
- Meskipun filesystem pulih, Windows mencatat beberapa Disk Event 7: `The device, \\Device\\Harddisk1\\DR3, has a bad block.` Karena itu, perangkat/connection health belum dapat dinyatakan sepenuhnya sehat; backup data penting tetap menjadi langkah berikutnya.

Failures and how to do differently:

- Pemeriksaan tanpa elevation gagal dengan `Access denied`; untuk status volume/disk dan CHKDSK pada drive bermasalah, minta akses administrator sejak awal.
- `chkdsk E: /f` pertama kali tidak dapat berjalan karena volume E: sempat tidak ter-mount secara normal. Jangan memaksa repair atau format ketika volume tidak terbaca; lakukan reconnect langsung ke port USB lain, hindari hub, dan batalkan prompt format.
- Jangan menyimpulkan kesehatan fisik dari `HealthStatus: Healthy` disk atau hasil `0 KB in bad sectors` saja. Event 7 bad block, Event 153 I/O retry, Event 129 UASP reset, dan pesan media error adalah sinyal terpisah bahwa SSD/kabel/port/enclosure masih berisiko.
- Jangan menganggap progres CHKDSK 100% sebagai selesai; tunggu ringkasan final dan lakukan verifikasi ulang `Get-Volume`, dirty flag, akses folder, serta event log.

Reusable knowledge:

- Untuk filesystem exFAT yang dirty/full-repair-needed dan pengguna melarang format, perintah yang berhasil adalah `chkdsk E: /f`; ini memperbaiki metadata filesystem tanpa memformat volume.
- Urutan verifikasi yang tervalidasi: `Get-Volume -DriveLetter E`, `fsutil dirty query E:`, akses listing `Get-ChildItem E:\`, lalu periksa event log provider `Disk`, `UASPStor`, `stor`, `exfat` untuk error baru.
- Perbaikan filesystem dapat berhasil sekaligus tetap meninggalkan risiko hardware. Setelah repair, segera backup file penting ke drive lain dan uji baca file penting; gunakan Safely Remove/Eject sebelum mencabut.

- Device: `ESD310C TS256GESD310C SCSI Disk Device`, Disk 1, USB, sekitar 256 GB.
- Initial status: `HealthStatus : Warning`, `OperationalStatus : Full Repair Needed`, `Volume - E: is Dirty`.
- Repair command: `chkdsk E: /f`
- Final CHKDSK evidence: `Windows has made corrections to the file system.`, `No further action is required.`, `0 KB in bad sectors.`
- Final verification: `HealthStatus : Healthy`, `OperationalStatus : OK`, `Volume - E: is NOT Dirty`.

messages.text:
ChatGPT kemarin kan kita sudah revamp yah, dan hasilnya seperti digambar SS ini tapi saya rasa masih kurang bagus dan rapih, coba kamu revamp tapi dirapihkan gitu loh, preview gambarnya kirim dulu disini sebelum kamu langsung implementasi?

ChatGPT kemarin kan kita sudah revamp yah, dan hasilnya seperti digambar SS ini tapi saya rasa masih kurang bagus dan rapih, coba kamu revamp tapi dirapihkan gitu loh, preview gambarnya kirim dulu disini sebelum kamu langsung implementasi?
Maksudnya "Akses file lokal sedang gagal, jadi memori dan panduan skill belum bisa saya baca." ?

Bukannya sudah saya ubah permissionnya menjadi Full access kok minta approval seperti ini?

<image name=[Image #1] path="C:\Users\aruna\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-clipboard-fe904699-129f-4fc8-b0cf-779d71dbf3ce.png">

</image>
Bukannya sudah saya ubah permissionnya menjadi Full access kok minta approval seperti ini?

Ya, Anda sudah memberi izin untuk menyimpan preview. **Dialog tadi muncul karena sesi alat yang saya terima masih menggunakan mode `workspace-write`, meskipun Anda sudah memilih Full access di aplikasi.** Jadi ada ketidaksesuaian antara pengaturan yang Anda sampaikan dan batas akses yang masih diterapkan pada eksekusi saya.

Urutannya tadi:

1. Saya mencoba menyimpan gambar ke `project-artifacts`, yang sebenarnya sudah termasuk folder yang boleh ditulis.
2. Proses gagal saat lingkungan sandbox mulai berjalan, dengan pesan `helper_unknown_error: setup refresh had errors`.
3. Saya mencoba ulang melalui jalur eksekusi di luar sandbox. Permintaan inilah yang memunculkan dialog **Allow once** pada screenshot.

**Jadi dialog itu bukan karena saya membutuhkan persetujuan ulang untuk desain atau penyimpanan gambar.** Itu muncul dari mekanisme izin eksekusi setelah sandbox gagal. Kalimat permintaan saya tadi kurang tepat karena terdengar seperti meminta izin pekerjaan yang sebenarnya sudah Anda berikan.

Pembacaan file melalui jalur tersebut berhasil, dan salinan preview juga sudah tersimpan di [header-navigation-concept-01.png](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261016-header-navigation-polish/header-navigation-concept-01.png). Source aplikasi belum saya ubah.

Yang belum saya pastikan adalah mengapa perubahan Full access belum tercermin pada sesi alat ini; saya belum punya bukti untuk menyimpulkan apakah penyebabnya sinkronisasi sesi atau masalah aplikasi.
Masih kurang bagus, jarak dan ukurannya masih pada kegedean dan sempit, rapihkan lagi?

Ini **preview revisi kedua**, dengan susunan yang lebih padat dan area halaman lebih luas.

Yang saya rapikan:

- **Bar atas lebih pendek**, dengan judul dan tombol aksi dalam satu baris.
- **Toolbar preview lebih ringkas**, tanpa kartu dan jarak luar yang besar.
- **Sidebar kembali ke daftar kategori**; detail pengaturan dibuka saat kategori dipilih sehingga panel tidak penuh oleh kontrol sekaligus.
- **Bingkai preview lebih tipis**, dan ruang kosong di sekeliling halaman dikurangi.
- **Bar zoom besar di bawah dihilangkan**, diganti informasi kecil di bagian bawah.

Gambarnya tersimpan di [preview revisi kedua](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261016-header-navigation-polish/header-navigation-concept-02.png).

**Belum ada perubahan source aplikasi.** Ini masih konsep gambar; ukuran piksel, font CMS, dan kerapatan kontrol perlu dipastikan pada implementasi, karena hasil gambar generatif belum menjamin ketepatan ukuran.
Kenapa selalu terlihat terlalu ramai yah jadi user pertama kali lihat tingkat kebingungannya tuh medium?

Iya, karena revisi tadi **baru mengecilkan elemen, belum mengurangi jumlah keputusan yang harus dipahami pengguna**. Jadi lebih padat, tetapi belum lebih sederhana. Saya terlalu fokus pada jarak dan ukuran.

Dari gambar, ada beberapa sumber keramaian yang jelas:

- **Pilihan perangkat muncul dua kali:** dropdown Desktop di kiri dan Desktop/Tablet/Mobile di atas preview. Pengguna baru harus menebak apakah keduanya punya fungsi berbeda.
- **Terlalu banyak informasi tampil bersamaan:** status tersimpan, aktif, ukuran preview, skala, posisi scroll, reset, enam kategori, serta bantuan di bawah.
- **Semua kategori mendapat perhatian hampir sama.** “Posisi & susunan” yang paling umum digunakan tampil sejajar dengan “Bayangan link” dan “Konfigurasi” yang lebih khusus.
- **Preview ikut berebut perhatian.** Foto hutan, headline besar, menu merah, dan tombol merah membuat pengguna melihat banyak titik dominan sebelum memahami harus mulai dari mana.

Jadi, penilaian Anda masuk akal. Tingkat kebingungannya belum kita ukur melalui uji pengguna, tetapi dari susunan visualnya memang belum ada **jalur mulai yang cukup jelas**.

Menurut saya, arah berikutnya perlu berubah seperti ini:

| Bagian | Arah perapihan |
|---|---|
| Bar atas | Cukup Kembali, judul halaman, dan Simpan. Status penyimpanan dibuat kecil di dekat tombol. |
| Pemilih perangkat | Satu tempat saja di atas preview; pilihan itu sekaligus menentukan perangkat yang sedang diatur. |
| Panel kiri | Langsung membuka pengaturan dasar, sehingga pengguna tidak bertemu enam pilihan awal sekaligus. |
| Pengaturan dasar | Dahulukan susunan logo/menu, lebar header, dan tinggi header. |
| Pengaturan khusus | Warna, detail jarak, bayangan, perilaku scroll, dan konfigurasi tetap tersedia melalui bagian lanjutan yang tertutup. |
| Kontrol preview | Ukuran, skala, reset, dan simulasi scroll masuk menu “Opsi preview”. |
| Area contoh halaman | Gambar hutan tetap dipertahankan, tetapi tinggi hero dan ukuran judul diturunkan agar header yang sedang diedit menjadi fokus. |

**Pengguna pertama kali seharusnya langsung memahami: “Saya atur di kiri, lihat hasilnya di kanan, lalu simpan.”** Detail lain baru muncul ketika dibutuhkan. Semua kemampuan lama tetap ada; yang berubah adalah kapan dan bagaimana ditampilkan.

Saya belum membuat gambar lanjutan atau mengubah source pada langkah ini. Penyederhanaan tersebut masih usulan desain; kemudahan penggunaannya belum diuji.
Ok coba kamu buat preview gambarnya

Ini **preview ketiga**, dengan informasi awal yang lebih sedikit supaya pengguna langsung tahu harus mulai dari mana.

- Panel kiri langsung menampilkan **pengaturan dasar**: susunan, lebar, dan tinggi header.
- Warna, jarak, bayangan, dan perilaku scroll ditempatkan dalam **Pengaturan lanjutan** yang tertutup.
- Pemilih **Desktop / Tablet / Mobile hanya muncul sekali**.
- Kontrol tambahan ditempatkan di **Opsi preview**, sehingga toolbar lebih tenang.
- Tombol **Simpan** menjadi aksi utama yang paling jelas.

[ Buka preview ukuran penuh ](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261016-header-navigation-polish/header-navigation-concept-03.png)

Belum ada implementasi atau pengujian interaksi. Foto hutan dan beberapa detail header pada gambar ini merupakan ilustrasi konsep; aset serta konfigurasi aktif belum diubah.
Lalu UI UX pengaturan lanjutannya seperti apa?

Seperti gambar di atas: **Pengaturan lanjutan membuka isi baru di sidebar yang sama**, sementara preview tetap terlihat di kanan.

Alur yang saya usulkan:

1. Klik **Pengaturan lanjutan** dari panel dasar.
2. Pilih bagian yang ingin diubah. **Hanya satu bagian terbuka pada satu waktu**, agar kontrol tidak menumpuk.
3. Ubah pengaturan dan lihat hasilnya langsung di preview.
4. Klik **Pengaturan dasar** untuk kembali. Nilai yang sedang diedit tetap dipertahankan.
5. Tombol **Simpan** tetap satu, di kanan atas, untuk menyimpan seluruh perubahan.

Pembagiannya seperti ini:

| Bagian | Isi pengaturan |
|---|---|
| **Warna & tampilan** | Latar header, warna teks/menu, garis tepi, dan kondisi interaksi menu. |
| **Ukuran & jarak** | Padding, margin, radius, dan pengaturan ukuran detail. |
| **Bayangan link** | Offset, blur, warna, serta inset. |
| **Perilaku scroll** | Fixed, sticky, dan transparansi sesuai opsi yang tersedia. |
| **Status & konfigurasi** | Aktivasi header di frontend dan konfigurasi teknis. |

Pada contoh ini, **Warna & tampilan** sedang terbuka. Kontrol warna cukup berupa swatch dan nilai; color picker baru muncul saat diklik. Penjelasan singkat di bawah pilihan kondisi membantu pengguna memahami apa yang sedang diubah.

[Buka gambar pengaturan lanjutan ukuran penuh](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261016-header-navigation-polish/header-navigation-advanced-concept-01.png)

Ini masih contoh susunan visual, belum inventaris lengkap semua kontrol. Source belum diubah; kelengkapan opsi lama dan perilaku responsif belum diverifikasi pada konsep ini.
Ok sekarang saya lihat UI UX sidebarnya terlihat masih terlalu ramai, coba direvamp lagi

Ini revisi sidebar dengan pendekatan **satu tugas dalam satu layar**. Contoh di gambar sedang mengatur **Warna menu**.

Tumpukan kategori dan accordion sudah dihilangkan dari layar detail. Pengguna cukup mengikuti tiga langkah:

1. **Kondisi menu** — pilih kondisi yang ingin diatur, misalnya Aktif.
2. **Bagian yang diubah** — pilih Teks, Latar, atau Garis.
3. **Warna** — tampilkan hanya kontrol untuk bagian yang dipilih.

Kategori lain diakses melalui **← Pengaturan lanjutan**. Dengan begitu, pengguna tetap tahu sedang mengedit apa, sementara preview selalu terlihat. Ruang kosong di bawah sidebar sengaja dibiarkan agar tidak semua opsi berebut perhatian.

[Buka preview sidebar terbaru](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261016-header-navigation-polish/header-navigation-sidebar-focused-01.png)

Source belum diubah dan alur interaksinya belum diuji. Konsekuensi desain ini: tampilan lebih sederhana, tetapi berpindah ke kelompok pengaturan lain membutuhkan satu langkah kembali.
Hmmmm buat ulang lagi dah dan coba kamu cari referensinya di dribbble kali aja kamu menemukan insight baru, lalu kamu buat ulang lagi previewnya

Ini preview baru dengan pendekatan **panel properti bertab**. Perubahan utamanya ada pada cara pengaturan disusun: pengguna bisa berpindah kategori tanpa masuk-keluar halaman detail.

Saya mencari referensi Dribbble, terutama [Settings sidebar — Carlota](https://dribbble.com/shots/21204331-Settings-sidebar) dan [Settings with Sidebar and Tabbed Detail Pane — usrnk1](https://dribbble.com/shots/18484986-Settings-with-Sidebar-and-Tabbed-Detail-Pane). Referensi Carlota tersedia lewat pencarian gambar; gambar langsung beberapa halaman Dribbble gagal dimuat, sehingga saya belum memeriksa detail visual semuanya.

Insight yang saya terapkan pada preview:

- **Tiga tab tetap: Susunan, Tampilan, Perilaku.** Posisi navigasi tidak berubah saat pengguna mengedit.
- **Label di kiri, nilai di kanan.** Kontrol warna lebih ringkas dan mudah dibandingkan antarbaris.
- **Kelompok Header dan Menu dipisahkan dengan garis tipis**, tanpa kotak besar atau deskripsi berulang.
- **Kondisi menu berada di samping judul Menu**, sehingga konteks pengaturan tetap terlihat.
- **Bayangan tetap tertutup sampai dibutuhkan.** Pengaturan khusus tidak memenuhi tampilan awal.

Menurut saya, arah ini lebih seimbang daripada versi sebelumnya: pengaturan yang berkaitan bisa terlihat bersama, tetapi sidebar tetap tenang.

[Buka preview ukuran penuh](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261016-header-navigation-polish/header-navigation-tabbed-inspector-01.png)

Belum ada perubahan source atau pengujian interaksi. Preview ini menunjukkan arah visual; kelengkapan seluruh opsi lama dan ketepatan ukuran masih perlu diverifikasi sebelum implementasi.

Codex could not read the local image at `/C:/Users/aruna/.codex/generated_images/01a143a5-ec0f-76e3-8d3b-bec51221cf21/exec-3fa81af5-71af-461d-a7f7-d4608fc37efc.png`: The filename, directory name, or volume label syntax is incorrect. (os error 123)
Elu gimana sih pas buat gambar previewnya bagus tapi pas diimplement jadi rusak dan berantakan TOLOL banget elu, ini kan pas elu buat gambar previewnya bagus ini?

Iya, **preview itu terlihat rapi, dan implementasi saya tadi tidak berhasil mempertahankan desainnya.** Anda sudah menyetujui tampilan yang jelas; hasil di aplikasi seharusnya mengikuti itu. Maaf, ini kesalahan cara kerja saya.

Saya membuat gambar sebagai konsep visual, lalu saat implementasi saya mengubah susunan kontrol pada halaman aktif **sebelum CSS dan seluruh detail form selesai diselaraskan serta diperiksa di browser**. Akibatnya, struktur baru bertemu aturan tampilan lama dan Anda melihat kondisi yang berantakan. Saya juga menggambarkan beberapa kontrol dalam preview yang tidak persis sama dengan kemampuan pengaturan asli, sehingga gambar tersebut belum menjadi acuan implementasi yang cukup akurat.

Seharusnya saya menyelesaikan tampilan di salinan terisolasi dengan **kontrol asli dan seluruh opsi yang sudah ada**, memeriksa hasilnya, lalu menunjukkan **screenshot browser dari implementasi nyata**. Setelah cocok dengan preview, baru memasangnya ke halaman aktif.

Versi sebelumnya sudah dipulihkan. Saya tidak melanjutkan perubahan sekarang.

Yang belum terbukti adalah implementasi yang benar-benar sesuai gambar tersebut; saya tidak akan menyebut gambar konsep sebagai bukti bahwa UI-nya sudah siap dipasang.
Coba kamu implementasi lagi design revamp terbaru yang kamu buat, harus sama persis dan bagus
Maksud saya implement dari preview gambarnya 100% tapi tetap disesuaikan juga jangan mentang-mentang sama 100% ukuran font dan icon gede-gede semua

**Sudah saya implementasikan ulang dan pasang di halaman aktif.** Susunan mengikuti preview terakhir, dengan ukuran yang disesuaikan untuk CMS: sidebar **300px**, label **12px**, kontrol **32px**, dan ikon kecil.

Ini **screenshot hasil implementasi nyata dari browser**, setelah seluruh penggantian file untuk pengujian dilepas:

![Hasil implementasi Header Navigation](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/implementations/20261016-header-navigation-refined/qa/live/final-appearance.png)

Yang sudah diterapkan:

- Kontrol warna sejajar: label di kiri, nilai di kanan.
- Pilihan **Normal, Active, Hover, Focus** berada dalam satu dropdown.
- Pengaturan shadow, sizing, dan configuration tetap tersedia.
- Seluruh teks antarmuka editor, bantuan, dialog, dan halaman contoh menggunakan **bahasa Inggris**.
- Semua **51 field lama, tujuh kelompok pilihan, dan tujuh kontrol penghubung** tetap dipertahankan.

Verifikasi pada halaman aktif sudah selesai: **271 pemeriksaan browser lulus tanpa error JavaScript**, termasuk seluruh **21 input angka**, profil responsif, warna, shadow, transparansi, scroll, dan perlindungan perubahan yang belum disimpan. Pengujian backend juga lulus: **36 tes, 327 assertions**. Screenshot desktop dan mobile sudah saya periksa.

Sudah saya rapikan, termasuk tambahan penyamaan lebarnya.

- **Border berlapis dihilangkan** pada input Height, tombol pilihan dalam grup, swatch warna, dan kontrol perangkat.

# Phoenix CMS Header Navigation received a multi-step visual polish pass and was saved for continuation

Rollout context: Work occurred in `D:\Laragon\www\laravel-13-phoenix` for `https://laravel-13-phoenix.aruna/awesome_admin/header-navigation`, using PowerShell and authenticated Chrome/Playwright checks. The user iteratively reported visual issues from screenshots and asked for focused refinements rather than another broad redesign. The session ended after the user asked to save the conversation for later continuation.

## Task 1: Unified header/hero background

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user initially said the previous revamp was “masih kurang bagus dan rapih” and asked for a preview before direct implementation, indicating that visual changes should be discussed/previewed and then implemented narrowly rather than treated as an excuse for an unbounded redesign.
- The final implementation preserved the forest preview and existing settings while fixing only the visible seam between header-side background and hero background.

Key steps:

- Investigated the handoff note, current CSS/JS/view sources, and Graphify references.
- Identified that the stage and hero were painting the same forest with different image positions/overlays.
- Changed fullscreen CSS so the preview stage owns one shared forest/overlay and the hero background is transparent.
- Verified the change with 16 authenticated Chrome checks covering shared background behavior, container-only/full-width backgrounds, transparent header, scrolling, Reset, and persistence after reload.

Reusable knowledge:

- The relevant fullscreen stylesheet is `public/assets/css/awesome-admin-header-navigation-fullscreen.css`.
- Header/container background behavior remains owned by the original renderer; the fullscreen CSS should not duplicate that logic.
- No database settings were saved and Graphify was intentionally not updated.

References:

- Artifact: `project-artifacts/implementations/20261016-header-navigation-unified-background/`
- Verification report: `project-artifacts/implementations/20261016-header-navigation-unified-background/verification-report.md`

- Handoff context: `E:\\AI\\Memories\\20261015-171349-phoenix-header-navigation-revamp-handoff.md`

## Task 2: Remove apparent double border around sidebar/panels

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user specifically reported that the sidebar border looked “tebal” and like a “double border,” then clarified that a border had disappeared entirely. This indicates they want one subtle divider preserved, not all borders removed.
- The assistant was expected to inspect the screenshot and computed styles, identify the exact overlapping layers, and make a minimal CSS correction.

Key steps:

- Browser computed-style inspection showed `.mock-control-pane` had a right divider while `.inspector-shell` and `.preview-card` each still had their own borders and shadows. Legacy rules in `awesome-admin-header-navigation.css` and theme CSS used `!important`, so ordinary overrides were insufficient.
- Applied `border: 0 !important` and `box-shadow: none !important` to `.inspector-shell` and `.preview-card`, leaving the wrapper’s single divider intact.
- Verified at 1440px, 1024px, and 430px: shell/preview borders and shadows were zero, the desktop sidebar had only one approximately 0.667px right divider, mobile switched to one top divider, and there was no horizontal overflow.

Reusable knowledge:

- Duplicate appearance came from three layers: the wrapper divider plus the inspector panel and preview card borders/shadows.
- When cleaning this UI, inspect `borderLeft`, `borderRight`, `borderTop`, `boxShadow`, pseudo-elements, and element rectangles with browser computed styles; do not rely only on source inspection.
- Preserve responsive behavior: desktop/tablet use a right divider; mobile uses a top divider.

References:

- Artifact: `project-artifacts/implementations/20261016-header-navigation-single-divider/`
- QA output: `project-artifacts/implementations/20261016-header-navigation-single-divider/qa/result.txt`

## Task 3: Restore the missing topbar horizontal border

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- After the double-border fix, the user reported “Yang bagian border disini jadi nggak ada alias hilang,” so future visual edits must distinguish the unwanted sidebar/panel borders from the intentionally retained horizontal separator beneath the title/action bar.

Oiya revamp jangan hanya untuk desktop view saja yah, termasuk tablet dan mobile viewnya agar benar-benar 100% responsive

Berikut preview revamp **Focused Reader**, termasuk penyesuaian **desktop, tablet, dan mobile**. Gunakan tombol perangkat untuk melihat perubahan tata letaknya; opsi desain pada preview dapat dipakai untuk mencoba alignment, lebar kolom, ukuran teks, jarak, dan cover.

visualize{"path":"D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261018-focused-reader/focused-reader.html"}

**Arah revamp yang saya sarankan:**

- **Judul menjadi fokus utama.** Ukurannya lebih tegas, dengan lebar yang terkontrol agar pemenggalan baris tetap nyaman.
- **Hierarki header diperbaiki:** kategori → judul → ringkasan → penulis/tanggal/waktu baca. Metadata tidak lagi mendahului judul.
- **Cover dan isi memiliki lebar berbeda.** Cover mendapat ruang lebih luas, sementara paragraf tetap berada dalam kolom baca maksimum sekitar 680px.
- **Jarak lebih konsisten.** Ada pemisahan yang jelas antara header, cover, paragraf, subjudul, kutipan, dan navigasi artikel.
- **Mobile memiliki komposisi sendiri.** Header rata kiri, judul mengecil secara responsif, metadata membungkus, cover menjadi 4:3, dan Previous/Next ditumpuk vertikal.

**Opsi setting yang saya usulkan** dikelompokkan menjadi enam bagian. Formnya mengikuti pola CMS yang sudah ada: label jelas, input ringkas, pemisah antarkelompok, dan kontrol Desktop / Tablet / Mobile untuk nilai yang responsif.

1. **Layout & spacing**
   - Lebar maksimum kolom isi dan cover secara terpisah.
   - Padding halaman per perangkat.
   - Jarak header–cover, cover–isi, antarparagraf, dan sebelum subjudul.
   - Gunakan setting shell yang sudah ada untuk padding/margin umum, agar tidak muncul dua kontrol yang mengatur hal sama.

2. **Header & typography**
   - Alignment header per perangkat; default center pada desktop/tablet, left pada mobile.
   - Ukuran judul, line-height, dan lebar maksimum judul.
   - Ukuran serta line-height ringkasan.
   - Ukuran isi dan subjudul, termasuk jarak antarbagiannya.
   - Pertahankan opsi tampil/sembunyikan judul serta ringkasan dinamis/custom yang sudah tersedia.

3. **Metadata**
   - Pertahankan pengaturan tanggal dan penulis yang sudah ada.
   - Tampilkan waktu baca pada detail; opsi datanya sudah ada, tetapi partial header yang diperiksa belum merendernya.
   - Posisi metadata di atas atau di bawah ringkasan; default di bawah.
   - Ukuran teks, jarak antaritem, dan separator yang konsisten.

4. **Cover**
   - Tampilkan/sembunyikan cover.
   - Rasio per perangkat: original, 16:9, 3:2, 4:3.
   - Lebar mengikuti kolom isi atau lebih lebar.
   - Object fit, posisi crop, dan radius.
   - Caption opsional. **Caption pada preview masih contoh**, sehingga sumber data caption perlu ditentukan saat implementasi.

5. **Article content**
   - Ukuran teks dan line-height per perangkat.
   - Jarak paragraf dan heading.
   - Tampilan blockquote: garis aksen, padding, ukuran teks.
   - Penanganan gambar, tabel, embed, dan teks panjang agar tetap muat di layar kecil.

6. **Article navigation**
   - Pertahankan pengaturan tampil/sembunyikan navigasi.
   - Pilihan dengan atau tanpa thumbnail.
   - Jarak, divider, dan ukuran judul artikel.
   - Dua kolom pada desktop/tablet, satu kolom pada mobile.

Untuk tahap pertama, saya memprioritaskan **layout, tipografi, spacing, metadata, dan cover** karena kelimanya langsung memperbaiki kenyamanan membaca yang Anda minta.

**Status verifikasi:** preview mandiri sudah diuji di browser pada lebar **320, 390, 768, 1024, dan 1440px** tanpa overflow horizontal pada konten contoh. Perpindahan perangkat berjalan, tidak ada error JavaScript, dan screenshot desktop/mobile sudah ditinjau. Hasilnya tercatat di [laporan verifikasi](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/project-artifacts/mockups/20261018-focused-reader/verification.json).

Pemeriksaan source mencakup [Focused Reader](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/resources/views/article/templates/detail/focused-reader.blade.php), [header detail](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/resources/views/article/templates/partials/detail-header-copy.blade.php), [normalisasi opsi](/D:/Laragon/www/laravel-13-phoenix/app/Support/Article/ArticleTemplateOptions.php), CSS frontend, fixture preview, dan bagian form styling. # Focused Reader article-template revamp was implemented, then corrected to use the CMS responsive typography system and given a working public-frontend link.

Rollout context: The work occurred in `D:\Laragon\www\laravel-13-phoenix` on PowerShell. The user initially requested an in-place preview and revamp of the Focused Reader article-detail template, including layout hierarchy, spacing, sizing, and settings. After reviewing the result, the user objected that the font sizes looked too large and requested that archive/detail article pages use the CMS's responsive font-size system, plus a direct button to the frontend article page.

## Task 1: Focused Reader layout and settings revamp

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user asked to revamp “Focused Reader” around “memperbaiki tatak letak, jarak dan hirerarki, ukuran dsb.” -> future similar work should treat hierarchy, spacing, proportions, and responsive behavior as first-class acceptance criteria rather than only changing colors or typography.
- The user wanted a preview and explicit setting options before/alongside implementation -> preserve the established CMS-native Template Options workflow and make settings understandable per device.
- Existing template defaults were deliberately preserved: the active live detail template was not changed and no production Save/commit/push was performed.

Key steps:

- Implemented a scoped Focused Reader layout with category/eyebrow, dominant title, summary, metadata, wide cover, narrower reading column, and previous/next navigation.
- Added responsive desktop/tablet/mobile layout values for widths, alignment, spacing, line heights, cover ratio/radius/fit/crop, navigation, and content handling.
- Added a Focused Reader options partial and integrated it into the existing Vue manager and Blade manager page.
- Added normalization/bounds handling in `ArticleTemplateOptions`; retained existing shell/header/display settings and exposed Focused Reader-specific options without changing the active default template.
- Added overflow protections for long headings/URLs, images, embeds, tables, code blocks, and navigation.
- Created a QA report, screenshots, and backups under `project-artifacts`.

Reusable knowledge:

- Main implementation files included `app/Support/Article/ArticleTemplateOptions.php`, `resources/views/article/templates/detail/focused-reader.blade.php`, `resources/views/article/templates/partials/detail-header-copy.blade.php`, `resources/views/manage_article/templates/index.blade.php`, new `resources/views/manage_article/templates/partials/options-focused-reader.blade.php`, `public/assets/css/article/article-frontend-2026.css`, `public/assets/css/article/article-template-manager-2026.css`, and `public/assets/js/vue3/manage_article_templates/vueV3-manage-article-templates-2026.js`.
- The initial implementation used pixel defaults such as title `48/40/32px`, body `18/18/17px`, heading `28/26/24px`, and quote `23/22/20px`; these were later superseded for typography by the shared CMS responsive system. Do not treat the original pixel typography as the current contract.
- The options UI intentionally retained layout, line-height, spacing, cover, and navigation controls while removing/hiding independent pixel-size controls after the user requested CMS-controlled responsive font sizing.

Failures and how to do differently:

- The first Article test run hit a CSRF/config-cache mismatch (`419` rather than the expected test behavior). Running with an isolated `APP_CONFIG_CACHE` restored the testing environment; do not delete or alter the active application cache as a workaround.
- The initial runtime verification encoded the superseded fixed-pixel font contract. It must not be used as current typography evidence; use `verify-cms-font.cjs` and the newer CMS-font QA artifacts instead.
- The first unauthenticated manager request redirected to `/auth/login`; later authenticated browser verification succeeded. Future manager UI checks should distinguish unauthenticated HTTP redirects from actual application failures.

References:

- QA report: `project-artifacts/mockups/20261018-focused-reader/IMPLEMENTATION-QA.md`
- Initial backup: `project-artifacts/backups/20261018-focused-reader-193342`
- Initial runtime verifier: `project-artifacts/mockups/20261018-focused-reader/verify-runtime.cjs` (historical/superseded for font assertions)
- Initial verification: `43` Article tests passed with `632` assertions; `7` Focused Reader/persistence tests passed with `73` assertions; `76` JavaScript tests passed; `21` responsive cases passed.

## Task 2: Align article typography with CMS responsive fonts and add frontend link

Outcome: success

Preference signals:

- The user clarified: “Saya ingin pada halaman article termasuk halaman detail articlenya itu menggunakan responsive font size seperti CMSnya” -> article archive, detail pages, and iframe previews should inherit the shared CMS typography contract rather than expose competing fixed-pixel font defaults.
- The user requested “ada tombol langsung ke halaman frontendnya si halaman article ini” -> the manager should proactively provide a clear public-page action beside the preview, with an explicit note that it uses saved settings.
- The user was concerned that the preview looked too large -> explain whether preview scaling is visual-only, then measure computed font sizes in the actual browser instead of relying on configured pixel values.

Key steps:

- Inspected `public/assets/css/theme-responsive-typography.css`, `SiteTypography`, the frontend layout, and article detail layout. The CMS contract uses `--ph-adaptive-font-size`, `--ph-mobile-content-font-size`, and `--ph-global-rfs-h1` through `--ph-global-rfs-h6`.
- Updated article frontend CSS so `.article-page` and `.article-detail` use the CMS base font and H1–H6 responsive tokens. Focused Reader summary/body now use the CMS font scale; old stored pixel values remain for compatibility but no longer override typography.
- Removed pixel-size controls from the Focused Reader options UI and replaced the explanatory copy with a CMS typography notice.
- Added `PublicArticleQuery` to `ManageArticleTemplateController` and exposed `frontendArchiveUrl` plus a `frontendDetailUrl` based only on the latest eligible published public article.
- Added a `View frontend` link to the manager preview header. Archive opens the public article index; detail opens the selected public article in a new tab with `noopener noreferrer`. If no eligible public article exists, a non-link message is shown.
- Authenticated browser verification confirmed the manager, Focused Reader panel, frontend link, preview iframe, and public detail page. The current saved detail template was `Knowledge + TOC`; it was intentionally preserved, so the link showed that template until Focused Reader is explicitly saved.

Reusable knowledge:

- CMS typography source of truth: `public/assets/css/theme-responsive-typography.css`, loaded by the frontend layout. It defines responsive heading tokens and Site Config-derived base/mobile font tokens.
[Kredensial disamarkan]
- The frontend link uses `route('cms.core.article')` for archive and `route('cms.core.article.detail', $frontendArticle->uri ?: $frontendArticle->id)` for detail.
- With the current Site Config during live browser verification, computed values were H1 `24px` at 390px mobile and `28px` at 834px/1440px; body/summary were CMS-computed rather than fixed Focused Reader pixel defaults. Public archive/detail had no horizontal overflow at 390, 834, and 1440px.

Failures and how to do differently:

- A first attempt to import Playwright as an ESM default failed (`The requested module './index.js' does not provide an export named 'default'`). The working approach used Node `createRequire` with the local `playwright-core` package.
- The configured Edge channel was initially unavailable (`Chromium distribution 'msedge' is not found`); using the existing executable path `C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe` worked.
- Do not store authentication credentials, cookies, or session state in project artifacts. The follow-up used authenticated browser verification but recorded only non-sensitive outcomes.
- The new public link intentionally does not show unsaved preview options; it opens the real public page using the last saved template/settings. This distinction should remain visible to users.

- Follow-up backup: `project-artifacts/backups/20261018-reader-frontend-link-194342`

- Live evidence: `project-artifacts/mockups/20261018-focused-reader/cms-font-live-verification.json`
- Authenticated verification passed: `32` preview checks (8 templates × 4 widths), `6` public archive/detail checks, `12` CMS typography cases, `43` Article tests/`632` assertions, `5` frontend-link/persistence tests/`92` assertions, and `76` JavaScript tests.
